frame: wall (x along wall, y up, z out of wall)
note: roughness_rms, recession and colour_delta_e are condition proxies (geometric and colour measurements). They are not validated deterioration classifications.

fields.face_area: scene^2, concave hull of points on the wall plane
fields.width/height: scene, minimum-area rectangle; width is the side nearer horizontal
fields.roughness_rms: scene, RMS residual to the stone's own plane
fields.recession: scene, median z minus median z of 6 nearest stones; negative = set back
fields.colour_delta_e: CIEDE2000 between the stone mean and the wall median colour
